meta_description: DJL Electrical Services in Newcastle. NICEIC-approved electrician offering domestic rewiring, fault finding, and emergency repairs. Call 07402 556065.
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics or tripped electrics in Newcastle? We diagnose and repair faults fast, any day of the week.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewiring, we handle all domestic and small commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Tripped switches, blown fuses, or dead circuits? We attend emergency repairs 24/7 and aim to restore power within the hour.

services.title: Fault Finding & Diagnosis
services.desc: Intermittent electrics or strange behaviour in your wiring? We locate and fix the root cause quickly, saving you money on guesswork.

services.title: Rewiring & Installation
services.desc: Full house rewiring, new circuits, and socket installation. We work to Building Regs and leave your home with a safety certificate.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes replaced with modern, safer consumer units. We handle all the paperwork and testing to bring your home up to code.

services.title: Lighting & Fixture Installation
services.desc: New light fittings, dimmer switches, and smart home wiring. Professional installation ensures safe operation and a neat finish.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: Periodic safety inspections and EICR reports for landlords, property sales, and peace of mind. We identify issues before they become dangerous.

about_pullquote: We fix problems properly the first time — no shortcuts, no dodgy bodges.
about_para_1: DJL Electrical Services has been serving Newcastle and Whickham for nearly two decades. We started because we saw too many householders left stranded by electricians who didn't show up or left jobs half-finished. Our NICEIC approval means every job is tested, certified, and backed by proper guarantees.
about_para_2: We take pride in getting to you fast and explaining what's wrong in plain English. Whether you've got a minor fault or need a full rewire, we turn up on time, do the job right, and leave your home safer than we found it. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About DJL

reviews.text: Had an absolute nightmare with electrics in my kitchen — lights kept flickering and I was worried about fire risk. Called DJL on a Friday afternoon and they came out the same evening. Found a loose connection in the consumer unit, sorted it in twenty minutes. Charged a fair price and very professional. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed the whole house rewired before we could sell. Got a few quotes but DJL was clear about what needed doing and didn't try to upsell us. Work was completed on time, left the place tidy, and the buyer's surveyor was happy. Great lads.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Tripped the main electrics at midnight — panic mode. Called DJL's emergency line and someone actually picked up. Electrician was with us in 45 minutes, found a water leak had damaged a socket, replaced it, tested everything. Reassured us it was safe. Proper emergency service, not a rip-off price.
reviews.author: David M.
